    path = 'data/wildfire/input/noaa_wildfires_monthly_stats.csv'

                out = pd.concat([df.head(5), df.tail(5)], ignore_index=True)
                out.insert(0, 'skiprows_used', skip)
                return out
        except Exception:
            continue

    df = pd.read_csv(path, engine='python')

def process(noaa_full):
    import pandas as pd

    df = noaa_full.copy()
    # Parse Date in YYYYMM integer form
    df['Date'] = df['Date'].astype(int)
    df['year'] = df['Date'] // 100
    df['month'] = df['Date'] % 100
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['year'].astype(str) + '-' + df['month'].astype(str).str.zfill(2) + '-01')

    # Filter since Jan 2000 (inclusive)
    df = df[df['date'] >= pd.Timestamp('2000-01-01')].sort_values('date')

    # Ensure Acres Burned numeric
    df['Acres Burned'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Acres Burned'], errors='coerce')

    # Rolling 3-month total (calendar consecutive months)
    df = df.sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    df['acres_3mo_total'] = df['Acres Burned'].rolling(window=3).sum()
    df['period_start'] = df['date'].shift(2)
    df['period_end'] = df['date']

    out = df.dropna(subset=['acres_3mo_total']).copy()
    # Keep only periods with consecutive months (no gaps)
    # Check that date differences are exactly 1 month between rows
    prev1 = out['date'] - out['date'].shift(1)
    prev2 = out['date'].shift(1) - out['date'].shift(2)
    # Month deltas vary; use PeriodIndex for exact month stepping
    p = out['date'].dt.to_period('M')
    consec = (p == p.shift(1) + 1) & (p.shift(1) == p.shift(2) + 1)
    out = out[consec]

    best = out.sort_values('acres_3mo_total', ascending=False).head(1)
    return best[['period_start','period_end','acres_3mo_total']]
